# Liquidity, Business Cycle, and Shale Updates

Report 113 | Published 2023-06-24 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-6-25/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/113.json)

Funding offsets and commodity supply constraints.

The update properly recognizes the RRP escape route and retains uncertainty around markets. The clear misses are the upcoming stagflationary recession, next-year oil stagnation despite falling rigs, and overstated EPD distribution growth. Spot ETF access and uranium direction receive credit with explicit causality and return limits.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Claims

## Framework lessons

- Track who funds government issuance.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
